current_candidate.summary: Spaces v26 fixes the exact Map 5 geometry bug from v25: the bridge no longer intersects the columns. With roadHalf=6.15, radius=2.15 and columnGap=0.65, each column center is at |X|=8.95 and its inner surface begins at |X|=6.80, leaving a real 0.65 world-unit abyss gap after the bridge edge. No horizontal geometry is rendered in that gap.

open_feedback: Verify the bridge visibly ends before each column and cannot be seen continuing underneath it.
Verify the 0.65 world-unit gap reads as abyss rather than an accidental seam.
Preserve pure-black column bases, tall upper shafts, hidden signs and the max-two sign cap.
